name: Iridescent Queen

description.content: Survivors hit by [Shock Therapy] or [Static Blast] gain a lingering [Static Charge] until it is discharged.
Survivors hit by the same [Shock Therapy] or [Static Blast] within [4m] of each other do not gain a [Static Charge].
Whenever a Survivor comes within [4m] of a Survivor with a [Static Charge], they are both shocked as if by [Shock Therapy], and the [Static Charge] is discharged.

quote: "Once we have established an effective method of treatment, we can focus on its efficient means of delivery." -H. Carter
